setup.pickTemplate: Pick a template to start from.
setup.templateClaudeBlurb: Anthropic subscription — OAuth via the Claude Code CLI.
setup.templateCodexBlurb: OpenAI Codex subscription — uses the Codex CLI with your ChatGPT account.
setup.templateAgyBlurb: Google Antigravity subscription — uses the agy CLI.
setup.templateFuguBlurb: Sakana Fugu multi-agent system via the `codex-fugu` launcher. Install it first (sakana.ai/fugu), then add it here.
setup.templateSakanaBlurb: Sakana Fugu via its native OpenAI-compatible API, driven by Better Agent's own agent loop. Needs an API key.
setup.templateCopilotBlurb: GitHub Copilot subscription — uses the `copilot` CLI, OAuth via `gh auth login`.
setup.templatePiBlurb: Minimal open-source coding agent (pi-mono). Bring any Anthropic/OpenAI/Google API key or a ChatGPT/Claude/Copilot subscription via its /login.
setup.templateQwenBlurb: Alibaba's Qwen Code CLI — free Qwen OAuth tier or a DashScope/OpenAI-compatible API key.
setup.templateCursorBlurb: Cursor's cursor-agent CLI — headless agent runs with your Cursor subscription (`cursor-agent login`).
setup.templateKimiBlurb: Moonshot AI's Kimi coding agent (kimi-k2) — sign in with its /login or KIMI_API_KEY.
setup.templateAmpBlurb: Sourcegraph's coding agent CLI. Headless (execute) mode needs paid Amp credits; sign in with `amp login`.
setup.templateOpencodeBlurb: Open-source multi-provider coding agent. Works out of the box with free models; connect providers via `opencode auth login`.
setup.templateOllamaBlurb: Local Anthropic-compatible models via Claude Code.
setup.templateZaiBlurb: Z.AI's Anthropic-compatible API via the `claude` CLI. Needs an API key.
setup.templateZaiOpenAIBlurb: Z.AI's native OpenAI endpoint (Coding-plan key) driven by Better Agent's own agent loop. This is where Z.AI's automatic prompt caching is reported, so it's cheaper on long contexts. Needs an API key.
setup.templateHetznerBlurb: OpenAI-compatible experimental inference. Requires an API token.
setup.templateCustomBlurb: Any Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Provide URL + key yourself.
setup.templateCustomOpenAIBlurb: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Driven by Better Agent's own agent loop. Provide URL, key, and model.

settings.crossSessionDelegateAutoHint: When on, delegate_to_session can fork another session and run without the confirmation picker. Continue-mode always asks. Off by default.
settings.contextStrategyHint: When the context window is full: 'Auto compact' lets the CLI summarize history. 'Start fresh chained session' creates a fresh provider subprocess chained to the previous one; the agent gathers any needed prior context itself via its tools.
settings.delegateTaskPolicyHint: How `delegate_task` routes a handed-off task: 'Auto' finds a fitting session (or creates one); 'Always create new' skips the search. The '+ approve' options ask you before dispatching.
settings.internalLlmHint: Runtime-profile assignments for the backend's own LLM tasks. Each task uses a runtime profile plus optional model and effort overrides. Anything left as 'Inherit' falls back to the default runtime profile, so the unconfigured state is never a hardcode.

settings.extensionsPermission.session_st: Can read session state and change session-owned data. Risk: a buggy or malicious extension could expose or alter your conversations.
settings.extensionsPermission.spawn_runs: Can start Claude, Codex, or AGY work. Risk: it can spend tokens, run tools, and trigger filesystem changes through the normal agent flow.
settings.extensionsPermission.internal_l: Can call trusted internal APIs. Risk: this is high trust because it can reach backend-only actions that regular pages cannot.
settings.extensionsPermission.filesystem: Can read or write files through approved extension paths. Risk: private code, notes, or secrets in files may be exposed or changed.
settings.extensionsPermission.network.ri: Can contact external services. Risk: data from Better Agent or your project could leave this machine.
settings.extensionsPermission.secrets.ri: Can request stored credentials through consent-gated flows. Risk: credentials are sensitive even when access is mediated.
settings.extensionsPermission.provider_c: Can read or modify provider settings. Risk: it can affect which models, tools, or config files future runs use.
settings.extensionsPermission.backend_ro: Can serve its own backend endpoints inside Better Agent. Risk: endpoint bugs can expose data or actions to the UI.
settings.extensionsPermission.storage.ri: Can persist its own data under Better Agent's extension storage. Risk: bad data may survive restarts until removed.
settings.extensionsPermission.mutates_se: Can change only the listed session flags. Risk: it can alter behavior for those specific features.
settings.extensionsPermission.marketplac: Can open Google or GitHub sign-in and securely store marketplace session tokens in the system keychain. Risk: it can act as your marketplace account.
settings.extensionsPermission.unknown.ri: This permission is not recognized by this UI. Treat it as high risk until the extension explains it.

harnessProfile.defaultHint: Live baseline — reflects your installed extensions. Changes apply everywhere unless a profile overrides them.
harnessProfile.extensionOffNote: Turned off in this profile — these settings do not apply until you enable it.
harnessProfile.baseProfileHint: Inherit this profile's resolved config, then apply this profile's overrides on top. Defaults to the live Default.
harnessProfile.pinHint: Used only when a session is created with this profile and the caller doesn't specify one.
harnessProfile.groupHint.mcp_servers: Tool servers this extension gives the agent. Turn one off and the agent can no longer call its tools in sessions using this profile.
harnessProfile.groupHint.skills: Instruction packs the agent loads on demand when a task matches their trigger. Turn one off and the agent never reads it.
harnessProfile.groupHint.instruction_nam: Text merged into the agent's system prompt on every turn — how this extension sets standing behavior. Turn it off and those rules are never sent.
harnessProfile.groupHint.setting_overlay: The extension's own configuration values. Secrets are kept in your operating system keychain and are shared by every profile.
harnessProfile.groupHint.user_instructio: Your own notes, appended to this extension's instructions. Use it to tell the agent how you want the extension used.
harnessProfile.groupHint.native_exposure: Also install these into the provider CLI's own configuration (Claude, Codex, AGY) so they apply outside Better Agent too. Off keeps them Better Agent-only.
harnessProfile.groupHint.frontend_module: Interface pieces this extension injects into Better Agent. Turn one off and it disappears from the app.
harnessProfile.groupHint.ui_surfaces: Where this extension shows up in the app. Turning a surface off only hides the entry point — the extension keeps working.
harnessProfile.groupHint.permissions: What this extension is allowed to reach on your machine. Required permissions come with the install; optional ones are yours to grant, and anything you leave off is denied.
harnessProfile.groupHint.disabled_builti: Better Agent's own built-in agent tools. Turn one off and the agent cannot use it in sessions using this profile.
Better Agent's built-in extensions. Turn one off and its tools, skills and instructions are withheld from sessions using this profile.
harnessProfile.groupHint.disabled_runtim: Runtime skills available to the agent. Turn all off for reviewer-style sessions that must not load skills.
harnessProfile.itemHint.ui_surfaces.quic: Show this extension's button in the session and settings views.
harnessProfile.itemHint.ui_surfaces.page: Give this extension its own page in the app's navigation.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.sess: Read and change session records — model, working directory, title, and other session fields.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.spaw: Start agent runs and launch provider processes on your machine.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.inte: Call Better Agent's own backend API using an internal identity token.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.file: Read and write files on your machine, outside Better Agent's own state directory.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.netw: Make outbound network requests to any host.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.secr: Read and store credentials in your operating system keychain.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.prov: Read and edit the provider CLIs' own configuration files (Claude, Codex, AGY).
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.back: Register its own HTTP endpoints on the Better Agent backend.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.stor: Keep its own persistent data inside Better Agent's state directory.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.mark: Sign in to the extension marketplace on your behalf.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.read: Read the specific session fields this extension declares.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.muta: Change the specific session fields this extension declares.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.mana: Set environment variables for the provider processes Better Agent launches.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.capa: Load the Better Agent capabilities this extension declares.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.in_p: Run its own code inside the Better Agent backend process, with everything the backend can reach.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.daem: Run a long-lived background process alongside the backend or supervisor.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.nati: Register its tool servers directly with the provider CLIs, outside Better Agent.
harnessProfile.itemHint.permissions.inte: Use Better Agent's internal model calls for the background tasks it declares.
